clue.text: Tune from America put on a record-player ahead of time

definitions.note: a verb: to adjust an instrument or engine

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: An American song is played on a gramophone before its scheduled slot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tune' reads as a noun, a song from America, but the answer is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To tune an engine or instrument is to make small corrections to it, a synonym.

clue.text: Like perfume from a poet like Keats or Shelley, not new

parts.note: taken as written

parts.note: Keats and Shelley were leading Romantic poets

clue.text: Was amusing, as judge allowed

parts.note: OK'd, given the OK, means approved or allowed

explanation.definitionFit: To have made jests or quips is to have been amusing, a plain synonym.

clue.text: It's hard to get caught, gripped by panic

taken as written

clue.text: Finally schedule times of hearing for alien

clue.text: Birds getting together when dawn chorus happens

wordplay.note: a cock and a crow are both birds, set side by side

taken as written

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

clue.text: Carrier of documents in lawsuit following murder

clue.text: Royal person slightly overlapping school in England, university in US

clue.text: Elementary text, something famous person doesn't need

second meaning: a celebrity 'needs no' presenting to an audience

explanation.definitionFit: A primer or basic guide to a subject, and also the act of presenting one person to another.

clue.text: Honest, i.e. not lying
